name: Informatics
deadline_note: Application periods: winter semester 01.02–31.05; summer semester 01.10–30.11. Apply through TUMonline.
semester_fee_note: The semester fee is payable in addition to tuition and varies by study location. Tuition stated is for full-time study; part-time tuition is charged proportionately.
language_requirement: Sufficient English language skills are required, with evidence submitted before the application deadline. The specific minimum score is not stated.
gre_requirement: No GRE requirement is stated in the provided text.
notes: Applicants need a recognized undergraduate degree and must pass a two-part aptitude assessment. Grades and written application documents are assessed using a point system; applicants may be admitted, rejected, or invited to an admissions interview. International applicants with qualifications obtained outside Germany generally need a uni-assist Preliminary Documentation (VPD), depending on their circumstances; they must also apply directly through TUMonline.
